title: Immunohistochemical Staining Protocol
author: Xiao Bing Tang
license_note: Confirmed via CrossRef DOI metadata: dx.doi.org/10.17504/protocols.io.kujcwun
materials: Slides are incubated with horseradish peroxidase (HRP)-conjugated secondary antibody (Santa Cruz Bio-technology) for 20 min in a humidifying box at room temperature.
Signals were visualized by using 3 ’3Pdiaminobenzidine (DAB; Sigma, UK) for 1 minute and terminated by incubated in distilled water.
Cover slides are mounted with gum.

steps.title: Deparaffinize slides
steps.instruction: Immerse slides in xylene, changing the solution twice; each immersion lasts 2 hours.

steps.title: Block non‑specific binding
steps.instruction: Incubate slides in phosphate‑buffered saline (PBS) containing 10 % goat serum for 20 minutes at room temperature.

steps.title: Primary antibody incubation
steps.instruction: Place slides in a humidifying box, add primary antibody, and incubate for 16 hours at 4 °C. Prepare negative‑control slides by incubating with PBS alone.

steps.title: PBS wash after primary
steps.instruction: Wash slides with PBS three times, 3 minutes each wash.

steps.title: Secondary antibody incubation
steps.instruction: Incubate slides with biotinylated secondary antibody for 30 minutes in a humidifying box at room temperature.

steps.title: Running water wash
steps.instruction: Wash slides with running water for 6 minutes.
